description:
I'm testing the most popular pressure washers from Amazon, Homes depot and Lowes to find out which is worth your money. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers! Watch all of our comparisons 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWbPHit6sG9uSpU8u2D_i_q-

I put three of the best-selling electric pressure washers head-to-head: the Sun Joe SPX3000 2030 PSI / 1.2 GPM Pressure Washer, Greenworks Pro 3000 GPW3000 3000 PSI / 2.0 GPM Pressure Washer, and DeWalt Suitcase 2600 PSI / 1.1 GPM Pressure Washer.

I test each pressure washer on dirty patio stones, a driveway, wood fencing and car panels to compare cleaning power, PSI, GPM, spray tips, ease of use and setup, storage, safety and overall value. If you’re trying to find the best pressure washer for homeowners or wondering how much PSI you actually need for cleaning a driveway, fence, patio or car, this comparison will help you choose the right machine.
